gloss: to end; to finish; to conclude

definitions.gloss: to end; to finish; to conclude; to be completed
definitions.explanation: To come to an end or bring something to completion. Used for events, programs, processes, and periods of time.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}が{終了|しゅうりょう}した。
キャンペーンは{今月末|こんげつまつ}で{終了|しゅうりょう}します。
examples.english: The campaign will end at the end of this month.

examples.japanese: システムの{更新|こうしん}が{終了|しゅうりょう}するまで、パソコンの{電源|でんげん}を{切|き}らないでください。
examples.english: Please do not turn off the computer until the system update has finished.

notes:
A formal, commonly used word for endings and completions. Frequently seen in announcements, signs, and system messages. More formal and definitive than {終|お}わる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受付|うけつけ}{終了|しゅうりょう}: registration closed
- {営業|えいぎょう}{終了|しゅうりょう}: business hours ended; closed for the day
- {販売|はんばい}{終了|しゅうりょう}: sales ended; no longer available
- {配信|はいしん}{終了|しゅうりょう}: streaming ended; service discontinued
- {終了|しゅうりょう}{時間|じかん}: ending time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {終|お}わる: to end — the most common everyday word; less formal
- {完了|かんりょう}する: to complete — emphasizes that a task or process has been fully finished
- {閉会|へいかい}する: to close (a meeting/ceremony) — used specifically for formal gatherings

USAGE:
Primarily intransitive (the event ends), but can be used transitively in some contexts ({作業|さぎょう}を{終了|しゅうりょう}する). Very common on signs and in digital interfaces, such as buttons labeled {終了|しゅうりょう}.
